notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout (Shopify store, no WAF/challenge; robots.txt is the standard Shopify template - only disallows /admin,/cart,/checkout,/account,/collections/*sort_by*, no Claude-specific or catalogue-browse disallow). Structure: extracted the site's real header mega-menu tree (parsed from the raw HTML <nav> markup, not just crawled link text) - two branches: 'Categories' (Indoor Lighting / Outdoor Lighting / Magnetic LED Lights / Downlights / Accessories) and 'Shop By Space' (Home Lighting>{Living Room,Bedroom,Kitchen}, Hospitality Lighting>{Restaurant,Hotel,Hospital}, Commercial Lighting>{Retail,Office}) - the latter kept in full per Rule 0 (room-organized lighting is in scope, no depth limit). Counts: for every leaf, exhaustively paged /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250, deduped by product id) rather than trusting the raw /collections.json 'products_count' field, which was empirically confirmed inflated (e.g. pendant-lights raw=174 vs exhaustive=119; wall-lights raw=160 vs 106; restaurant-collection raw=538 vs 382; retail-collection raw=267 vs 217; office-collection raw=376 vs 272) - consistent with the known Shopify products_count unreliability. Mixed roll-ups (title-inspected, not padded): the 5 Magnetic LED Lights collections (5/10/20/20-eco/30 MM) each mix genuine fixtures (spot/linear/pendant/downlights) with track-mounting hardware (TRACK CHANNEL, L/T/CROSS/STRAIGHT CONNECTOR, INPUT MODULE, INLINE DRIVER) in the same collection - every title in all 5 (small collections, single page each) was manually read and only genuine fixtures counted: 5MM 4/5, 10MM 4/9, 20MM 5/10, 20MM-Eco 3/8, 30MM 10/16. The 7 large room/space collections (living-room, bedroom, kitchen, restaurant, hotel, retail, office) were also scanned by title for the same hardware plus smart-switch/automation panels (MAGSYNC/HOGAR/NEXA touch-switch panels, IR blasters/controllers) and literal bulbs ('...BULB LAMP', '...BULB FOR <fixture>') mixed into the listings; matches subtracted (bedroom -1, restaurant -17, hotel -4, retail -15, office -17; living-room/kitchen/hospital-lights had none). Regex was iteratively tightened to avoid false positives - confirmed 'CONCRETE BULB HOLDER PENDANT LIGHT', 'BRASS HOLDER HANGING WITHOUT LAMP', 'NICO METAL WIRE CAGE HANGING LIGHT' and 'CYLINDRICAL GU10 BULB OUTDOOR WALL LIGHT' are genuine fixtures (kept), while '...BULB LAMP' and '...BULB FOR <fixture>' items are literal replacement bulbs (excluded). Whole-category exclusions applied per company brief (exclude bulbs/fans/wiring): the standalone 'Bulb Lamps' collection (10 items, all literal LED/filament bulbs, verified by title), 'Switchers' (touch-switch panels/IR blasters), 'LED Drivers' (power-supply/driver modules), and 'Track Channel' (rail/connector hardware) were dropped entirely as non-fixture electrical/wiring hardware. 'Strip Lights' (3 items, genuine LED rope/strip fixtures) kept as a standalone leaf since it was the only in-scope item left in the 'Accessories' menu group after the above exclusions. Scope: 'Mirror Wall Lights' and ~90 other internal /collections.json entries (Contemporary, Vintage Lights, Crystal/Glass/LED Chandeliers, Wood & Bamboo/Metal/Glass Pendant Lights, Wall Sconces, Ceiling Lights, Bedside Lights, etc.) are not part of the site's navigable header menu - confirmed by absence from the parsed <nav> markup - and are redundant material/style re-cuts of the primary type collections already counted here (e.g. 'Mirror Wall Lights' titles are all wall-light fixtures already inside the Wall Lights count), so excluded to avoid double-counting; not treated as a separate mirrors category since none are actual mirror products. 'Sale', 'New Arrivals', 'Best Sellers', 'Customized Lighting' (request-quote service page), store-location pages, and blog are excluded per NEVER EXTRACT rule. No duplicate-company signal: Ankur Lighting is a distinct Delhi-based DTC/showroom lighting brand (Khan Market, East of Kailash stores) with its own product line (ANKUR-branded fixtures plus a few OEM electrical-component lines like Fulham/Osram/Meanwell drivers, which are themselves excluded as wiring hardware).
